tools.name: nexudus_list_coworkers
tools.description: List coworkers (members and customers) of the Nexudus space, with paging, sorting and an optional full-name filter. Summary records only; use nexudus_get_coworker for every field. Nexudus API: GET /api/spaces/coworkers.

tools.name: nexudus_get_coworker
tools.description: Get one coworker (member or customer) with all fields by id. Nexudus API: GET /api/spaces/coworkers/{id}.

tools.name: nexudus_list_bookings
tools.description: List resource bookings (desks, rooms, studios) with paging, sorting and an UpdatedOn window. Nexudus API: GET /api/spaces/bookings.

tools.name: nexudus_get_booking
tools.description: Get one resource booking with all fields by id. Nexudus API: GET /api/spaces/bookings/{id}.

tools.name: nexudus_list_resources
tools.description: List bookable resources (desks, meeting rooms, studios) with paging, sorting and an optional name filter. Nexudus API: GET /api/spaces/resources.

tools.name: nexudus_get_resource
tools.description: Get one bookable resource with all fields by id. Nexudus API: GET /api/spaces/resources/{id}.

tools.name: nexudus_list_checkins
tools.description: List coworker check-ins at the space with paging, sorting and an UpdatedOn window. Nexudus API: GET /api/spaces/checkins.

tools.name: nexudus_list_coworker_invoices
tools.description: List invoices issued to coworkers, with paging, sorting, an optional invoice-number filter and an UpdatedOn window. Nexudus API: GET /api/billing/coworkerinvoices.

tools.name: nexudus_get_coworker_invoice
tools.description: Get one coworker invoice with all fields by id. Nexudus API: GET /api/billing/coworkerinvoices/{id}.

tools.name: nexudus_list_my_profiles
tools.description: List the coworker profiles of the signed-in Nexudus user, grouped by network, with the user's own details. Good first call to confirm which space this login reaches. Nexudus API: GET /api/sys/users/coworkers.
